findings.description: prepare captures previous_active but activate does not enforce it. Existing activate_release calls save_json, which captures the latest ACTIVE at write-time and therefore can overwrite an intervening activation without comparing the preparation baseline. Expected pin must cross the activation API and be checked at publication; test stale activation and mid-verification race.
